fix(postgres): keep WITH ORDINALITY alias columns on LATERAL UNNEST [GROK] (#8463)

* fix(postgres): keep WITH ORDINALITY alias columns on LATERAL UNNEST

_parse_unnest stores the ordinality name on Unnest.offset after popping it
from the table alias. Moving that alias onto Lateral then dropped the extra
column, so LATERAL UNNEST(...) AS r(v, idx) round-tripped as AS r(v).

* fix(postgres): keep LATERAL UNNEST ordinality column in lateral_sql

* refactor: gate lateral ordinality on UNNEST_WITH_ORDINALITY, simplify checks, add tests

---------

Co-authored-by: vaggelisd <daniasevangelos@gmail.com>
